Serika's null reading.summary: The crystal did not read zero: it returned a value with no category. Serika chose the word misfire, is spying to learn whether the player is a third such case, and holds two Church-sealed precedents.
Serika's null reading.sources: world hiddenInfo (Court Mage Serika Amamiya); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Serika knows the reading was a null value her system has no category for; 'misfire' was a chosen word that buried the distinction.
Her spies watch the player to learn whether she is watching a third null; she knows of two prior cases.

Both prior cases were summonings of five, both fifth readings reported as zero by court mages later struck from the registries, and both ended in Church-sealed recalibrations: the blind spot is centuries old.
steps.milestone_gate: The Wharf raid (about Day 60) or Serika's private alliance offer

steps.reveal: Serika will certify a null reading as real, with her signature, before the throne, knowing what happened to the last two names; or she offers a private alliance with honest strings.

Rin's copied logs.summary: Rin copied the measurement logs before the Court sealed them. They prove the reading was authored, not measured. Two oaths collide.
Rin's copied logs.sources: world hiddenInfo (Rin Amasaka); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Rin does not believe the verdict and trains before dawn to earn a title that feels borrowed.
Rin secretly copied the summoning ritual's measurement logs before the Court sealed them.
The logs prove the fifth reading was a blank value the crystal could not categorize, reported as zero: authored, not measured.
steps.milestone_gate: Her first honest talk with Daigo (joint op, about Day 60)

steps.reveal: She has rehearsed the words to hand back the Sword Hero title and will stand beside the player even against orders.
steps.milestone_gate: The player's power public, or the Almoner showdown

Yui's fifth anchor.summary: A fifth anchor point was etched into the summoning circle and chiseled over, with marks older than this summoning: the five-then-four pattern is a recurring erased role.
Yui's fifth anchor.sources: world hiddenInfo (Yui Nakahara); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Yui keeps a hidden ledger of Court inconsistencies that would ignite a succession-level scandal.
The circle's array had a fifth anchor point deliberately etched, then chiseled over.
The chisel marks are older than this summoning: the five-then-four pattern has happened before, and the archive has a gap in the exact shape of every previous fifth.
Yui is searching for one earlier fifth summon, alive or accounted for; the Almonry's sleepers answer her.

Daigo's buried number.summary: Daigo's reading was the second-lowest of the four and the Court buried it; his code is to pay debts in person at full weight.
Daigo's buried number.sources: world hiddenInfo (Daigo Hoshimura); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Daigo trains past sense toward a fight big enough to apologize inside: a debt for laughing at the fifth summon on day one.
His own Blessing reading was the second-lowest of the four and the Court buried it.
Rin's copied logs and his buried number are two halves of one file: the Court edits the record twice over.
steps.milestone_gate: First honest Rin and Daigo talk (about Day 60)

Suzuha's engineered engagement.summary: The marriage shortlist has narrowed to two names; one house is funding border provocations to make the alliance look urgent. The evidence runs through her maids.
Suzuha's engineered engagement.sources: world hiddenInfo (Suzuha Sumeragi); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: The marriage shortlist has quietly narrowed to two names.
One candidate's house is funding border provocations specifically to make the alliance look urgent.
Her evidence chain runs through loyal maids who would be destroyed in retaliation; she needs a deniable outsider with no house allegiance.
If the player helps break the engagement and shields the maids, they earn her personal, unconditional favor.

Toma's bounty top-ups.summary: Toma has been sending part of his hero stipend to the Guild as anonymous bounty top-ups on postings near the player; Serika's teams flagged the anomaly.
Toma's bounty top-ups.sources: world hiddenInfo (Toma Kirisawa); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: The anonymous top-ups on Guild postings near the player are Toma's.
Serika's verification teams flagged the payments as an anomaly and the Court will ask him to explain.
His honest answer: the kingdom owes the fifth summon a debt and he has been paying the interest; he has already chosen the five over Crown orders.
Toma's count of five and Yui's fifth anchor are the same fact; when they compare, the four heroes become the fifth summon's search party.
steps.milestone_gate: Yui and Toma compare counts (about Day 60)

Ren's second chance.summary: Ren is Reborn from Earth and has told no one. His unperformed song is an Earth melody; the board's masked attendant has been requesting his unperformed pieces.
Ren's second chance.sources: world hiddenInfo (Ren Tsukishiro); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Ren was a musician in a previous life and arrived with the ability to weave magic into music; he has told no one.
An Earth melody he plays is recognized by another person: his first secret shared.
The masked attendant at three galas, requesting songs by name, is the board's scout; Ren fits its profile.
steps.milestone_gate: The attendant requests his unperformed song

steps.reveal: The terror under the charm is that exposure collapses his second chance: that the talent was only magic and the man was never great.
steps.milestone_gate: A private talk, or the Almoner showdown

Yumi's curse.summary: Yumi's emotion-reading is her mother's curse: she feels everyone's emotions but her own, and has to deduce hers from her body. Her mother fled the board twenty years ago.
Yumi's curse.sources: world hiddenInfo (Yumi Aokiba); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Her emotion-reading is a curse her mother placed on her as a child, not foxkin intuition.
The curse cracks around the player: she feels one thing unmediated, and her forensic narration fails.
A resurfaced old enchantment ties her glyphwork to House Souen's information networks; her cart may need its getaway function.
Her mother fled the board's recruitment twenty years ago and cursed her daughter so no one's kindness could steer her; the board's couriers feel like nothing to Yumi for the same reason.

Mizuho's twenty-year case.summary: A retired A-Rank notices solo, talented, no-family adventurers taking jobs from a private board that bypasses her counter; two have not come back; her own incident began the same way.
Mizuho's twenty-year case.sources: world hiddenInfo (Mizuho Kaimaku); arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7

steps.reveal: Mizuho has counted solo, talented, no-family adventurers taking private-board work; two have not come back.
The incident she does not discuss, twenty years ago, began exactly the same way.
She is rebuilding the old case alone, off the books, and has begun wearing the second dagger; she invites a first-light spar with no witnesses.
steps.milestone_gate: Player digs up her A-Rank record

steps.reveal: Her party was recruited through the same board; a friend sealed a door so she could escape and was taken.
steps.milestone_gate: The spar, then the Wharf raid

The Almoner's board.summary: The private posting board is run by the Church's Almonry in the Temple District. Its attendants recruit the unmeasured and put them to sleep in glass beneath the Almonry.
The Almoner's board.sources: arc-bible.md sections 2 and 5 to 7; Church of the First Light faction hiddenInfo

steps.reveal: The board's couriers are perfectly calm and carry chalk-lanterns; they are attendants, not adventurers.
The vanished are alive, asleep in glass cradles, held somewhere under a temple.
steps.milestone_gate: Kazuki's vanishing, then a lead from Mizuho or Yumi

steps.reveal: The board is the Almonry's, in the Temple District, and the Almoner is Archbishop Isamu Tokiwa.
The Almoner recalibrates anomalies into the Lattice beneath the Almonry to hold a prophesied convergence from forming; the same script sealed Serika's two precedents and took Mizuho's party.
